meaning.en: Persistence overcomes all; constant effort brings success.
meaning.zh: 水不断地滴，可以把石头滴穿。比喻只要坚持不懈，事情就一定能成功。

equivalents: constant dripping wears away the stone
slow and steady wins the race

examples.zh: 学习要有水滴石穿的精神。
examples.en: Learning takes the persistence of water wearing away stone.

examples.zh: 绳锯木断，水滴石穿。
examples.en: A rope saws through wood; dripping water pierces stone.

story.en: Magistrate Zhang Guaiya sentenced a clerk who stole one coin a day: "One coin a day is a thousand coins in a thousand days. A rope saws through wood; dripping water pierces stone."
story.zh: 张乖崖判一小吏每天偷一钱的案子："一日一钱，千日千钱，绳锯木断，水滴石穿。"

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Often with 绳锯木断.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常与"绳锯木断"连用。

meaning.en: To repay kindness with ingratitude or harm.
meaning.zh: 受人恩惠，不但不报答，反而用仇恨来回报。

equivalents: bite the hand that feeds you

examples.zh: 我帮了他，他却恩将仇报。
examples.en: I helped him, and he bit the hand that fed him.

examples.zh: 恩将仇报的人不值得交往。
examples.en: People who repay kindness with harm aren't worth knowing.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: To suddenly see the error of one's ways.
meaning.zh: 很快地彻底悔悟。

examples.zh: 在父母的劝说下，他终于幡然悔悟。
examples.en: Persuaded by his parents, he finally saw the light.

examples.zh: 希望他能幡然悔悟，重新做人。
examples.en: I hope he'll come to his senses and start afresh.

usage.en: Predicate. 幡 is fān. Also written 翻然悔悟.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"翻然悔悟"。

natural: Even chickens and dogs rising to heaven

meaning.en: When one person rises, all their hangers-on benefit too.
meaning.zh: 比喻一个人得势，和他有关系的人也跟着得势。

examples.zh: 他当上局长后，亲戚朋友都鸡犬升天。
examples.en: When he became bureau chief, all his relatives and friends rode on his coat-tails.

examples.zh: 一人得道，鸡犬升天。
examples.en: When one man attains the Way, even his chickens and dogs ascend to heaven.

story.en: Legend says Liu An, Prince of Huainan, became an immortal; his chickens and dogs pecked and licked the leftover elixir and ascended to heaven with him.
story.zh: 传说淮南王刘安修炼成仙，剩下的仙药被鸡狗吃了，也都升了天。

usage.en: Usually in 一人得道，鸡犬升天. Derogatory.
usage.zh: 常说"一人得道，鸡犬升天"。贬义。

meaning.en: To relapse into old (bad) habits.
meaning.zh: 老脾气、老习惯又重新出现。

equivalents: a leopard can't change its spots

examples.zh: 他戒酒没几天就故态复萌了。
examples.en: He stopped drinking for just a few days before relapsing.

examples.zh: 检查组一走，这家餐馆又故态复萌。
examples.en: As soon as the inspectors left, the restaurant went back to its old ways.

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Holding talent but meeting no opportunity

meaning.en: Talented but unrecognised.
meaning.zh: 有才能，但得不到施展的机会。

examples.zh: 他总觉得自己怀才不遇。
examples.en: He always feels his talent goes unrecognised.

examples.zh: 许多古代诗人都有怀才不遇的感慨。
examples.en: Many ancient poets lamented that their talents were overlooked.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

natural: People's hearts are not as in ancient times

meaning.en: People aren't as honest as they used to be.
meaning.zh: 指人心奸诈、刻薄，没有古人淳厚。

equivalents: people aren't what they used to be
the world's going to the dogs

examples.zh: 老人常常感叹人心不古。
examples.en: The old often lament that people aren't what they used to be.

examples.zh: 不能一遇到骗子就说人心不古。
examples.en: Meeting one con man doesn't mean everyone has gone bad.

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 世风日下.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"世风日下"连用。

natural: Touching one kind and understanding those beside it

meaning.en: To learn one thing and apply it to similar cases.
meaning.zh: 掌握了某一事物的知识或规律，进而推知同类事物的知识或规律。

examples.zh: 学会了一种编程语言，其他的就能触类旁通。
examples.en: Once you learn one programming language, the others come by analogy.

examples.zh: 学习要善于触类旁通。
examples.en: Be good at applying what you learn to similar cases.

story.en: The Book of Changes: "Extend it and develop it, touch on its kind and enlarge it" (引而伸之，触类而长之), and all affairs under heaven are covered.
story.zh: 《周易·系辞上》："引而伸之，触类而长之，天下之能事毕矣。"

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: The lingering notes circling the rafters

meaning.en: (Of music) so beautiful it lingers in the mind.
meaning.zh: 形容歌声或音乐优美，余音长久回荡。

examples.zh: 她的歌声余音绕梁，令人难忘。
examples.en: Her singing lingered hauntingly — unforgettable.

examples.zh: 音乐会结束了，那旋律仍余音绕梁。
examples.en: The concert was over, but the melody still lingered in our ears.

story.en: The singer Han E sang for her supper in Qi; after she left, "the lingering notes circled the rafters and did not stop for three days" (余音绕梁欐，三日不绝).
story.zh: 韩娥过齐国卖唱求食，离开后"余音绕梁欐，三日不绝"。

usage.en: Predicate.

natural: Reciting records but forgetting one's ancestors

meaning.en: To forget one's roots or heritage.
meaning.zh: 比喻忘本，也比喻对本国历史的无知。

equivalents: turn one's back on one's heritage

examples.zh: 出国多年也不能数典忘祖。
examples.en: Even after years abroad, you shouldn't forget your roots.

examples.zh: 不了解自己的历史，就是数典忘祖。
examples.en: Not knowing your own history is turning your back on your heritage.

story.en: The Jin envoy Ji Tan, asked why Jin sent no tribute vessels, said Jin had never received any from the Zhou king. The king listed the gifts Jin had received and mocked: "Reciting the records, you forget your own ancestors" — Ji's ancestors had been the Zhou archivists.
story.zh: 籍谈说晋国从未受过周王赏赐，周景王列举赏赐后讥讽他"数典而忘其祖"——籍谈的祖先正是管典籍的官。

usage.en: Predicate. 数 is shǔ (to recount).

meaning.en: Delicately beautiful and appealing.
meaning.zh: 形容姿态娇柔，引人怜爱。

examples.zh: 她穿着白裙子，楚楚动人。
examples.en: In her white dress, she looked delicately pretty.

examples.zh: 小女孩含着泪水，楚楚动人。
examples.en: The little girl, eyes brimming with tears, was utterly endearing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. About young women or girls.

meaning.en: Partners with different, hidden agendas.
meaning.zh: 比喻共同做一件事而各有各的打算。

examples.zh: 两家公司合作，其实同床异梦。
examples.en: The two companies are partners, but each has its own agenda.

examples.zh: 这对夫妻同床异梦，早已没有感情。
examples.en: The couple live together but lead separate lives emotionally.

story.en: Chen Liang wrote to Zhu Xi that though they shared a cause, "in the same bed, each dreams his own dream" (同床各做梦).
story.zh: 陈亮《与朱元晦书》："同床各做梦，周公且不能学得，何必一一说到孔明哉？"

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Muddle-headed; confused.
meaning.zh: 形容头脑不清楚，不明事理。

examples.zh: 他糊里糊涂地签了合同。
examples.en: He signed the contract in a muddle.

examples.zh: 我被他说得糊里糊涂。
examples.en: His explanation left me completely confused.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Colloquial; 里 is often neutral in speech (húli hútu).

meaning.en: To return good for evil.
meaning.zh: 不记别人的仇，反而给他好处。

examples.zh: 他以德报怨，帮助了曾经伤害他的人。
examples.en: He returned good for evil and helped the person who'd hurt him.

examples.zh: 以德报怨需要宽广的胸怀。
examples.en: Turning the other cheek takes a big heart.

story.en: Someone asked Confucius about repaying injury with kindness. He replied: "Then with what will you repay kindness? Repay injury with justice, and kindness with kindness" (以直报怨，以德报德).
story.zh: 或问孔子："以德报怨，何如？"子曰："何以报德？以直报怨，以德报德。"

usage.en: Predicate. Note Confucius actually questioned this ideal.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。孔子对此其实持保留态度。

natural: The disaster reaches the fish in the pond

meaning.en: Innocent bystanders suffer; collateral damage.
meaning.zh: 比喻无端受连累而遭到祸害。

examples.zh: 两国贸易战殃及池鱼，许多小企业倒闭了。
examples.en: The trade war caused collateral damage, and many small firms went bust.

examples.zh: 他们吵架，我也殃及池鱼挨了骂。
examples.en: They were fighting and I got caught in the crossfire.

story.en: The saying runs: "When the city gate catches fire, the fish in the moat suffer" (城门失火，殃及池鱼) — the moat is drained to fight the fire.
story.zh: 杜弼《檄梁文》："楚国亡猿，祸延林木；城门失火，殃及池鱼。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often in 城门失火，殃及池鱼.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"城门失火，殃及池鱼"。

natural: Dong Shi imitating Xi Shi's frown

meaning.en: Clumsy imitation that makes things worse.
meaning.zh: 比喻胡乱模仿，效果很坏。

examples.zh: 盲目模仿明星的穿搭，只会东施效颦。
examples.en: Blindly copying celebrities' outfits only makes you look like a poor imitation.

examples.zh: 这家店抄袭名牌设计，结果东施效颦。
examples.en: The shop copied a famous brand's design and ended up with a clumsy knock-off.

story.en: The great beauty Xi Shi frowned from heart pain, and looked lovely. Her plain neighbour (later named Dong Shi) copied the frown — and people fled at the sight.
story.zh: 西施心痛皱眉，更显美丽。邻居丑女东施模仿她皱眉，人们见了都躲开。

usage.en: Predicate or object.

meaning.en: To take advantage of someone's misfortune.
meaning.zh: 趁人危难时去要挟或损害人家。

examples.zh: 趁着灾情抬高物价，是乘人之危。
examples.en: Raising prices during a disaster is preying on the vulnerable.

examples.zh: 君子不乘人之危。
examples.en: A gentleman doesn't take advantage of others' misfortune.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: To travel far across the oceans.
meaning.zh: 远道渡过重重海洋。指到很远的地方去。

examples.zh: 他远涉重洋去美国留学。
examples.en: He travelled across the oceans to study in America.

examples.zh: 这批文物远涉重洋，终于回到祖国。
examples.en: The relics crossed the seas and finally came home.

usage.en: Predicate. 重 is chóng (layer upon layer).

natural: Cutting the foot to fit the shoe

meaning.en: To force reality to fit a rigid framework.
meaning.zh: 把脚削小以适合鞋子。比喻不合理地迁就现成条件，或不顾具体条件生搬硬套。

equivalents: force a square peg into a round hole

examples.zh: 为了符合模板而改变内容，是削足适履。
examples.en: Changing content to fit a template is forcing a square peg into a round hole.

examples.zh: 引进外国经验不能削足适履。
examples.en: Importing foreign experience mustn't be Procrustean.

story.en: The Huainanzi: "To harm what one nourishes for the sake of nourishing it is like cutting the foot to fit the shoe, or trimming the head to fit the hat."
story.zh: 《淮南子》："夫所以养而害所养，譬犹削足而适履，杀头而便冠。"

usage.en: Predicate. 削 is xuē; 履 is lǚ.

natural: A hundred battles, a hundred victories

meaning.en: Victorious in every battle; invincible.
meaning.zh: 每战必胜。形容所向无敌。

examples.zh: 知己知彼，百战百胜。
examples.en: Know yourself and your enemy, and you'll win every battle.

examples.zh: 这位律师百战百胜。
examples.en: The lawyer has a perfect record.

story.en: Sunzi: "Winning a hundred victories in a hundred battles is not the height of skill; subduing the enemy without fighting is." The popular saying 知己知彼，百战百胜 adapts his "知彼知己，百战不殆".
story.zh: 《孙子·谋攻》："百战百胜，非善之善者也；不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也。"又有"知彼知己，百战不殆"。

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 知己知彼.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"知己知彼"连用。

meaning.en: If the foundation is gone, what depends on it cannot survive.
meaning.zh: 皮都没有了，毛往哪里依附呢？比喻事物失去了借以生存的基础，就不能存在。

equivalents: cut off the branch you're sitting on

examples.zh: 公司倒了，员工的饭碗也就没了，皮之不存，毛将焉附。
examples.en: If the company goes under, so do the jobs — without the skin, where would the hair grow?

examples.zh: 环境破坏了，旅游业也会皮之不存。
examples.en: If the environment is destroyed, tourism loses its foundation.

story.en: Qin, in famine, asked Jin for grain, which Jin refused despite past aid. A Jin minister warned: "If the skin does not exist, where will the hair attach?" — breaking faith would destroy Jin's own standing.
story.zh: 秦国遭饥荒向晋国借粮，晋国不肯。大夫庆郑说："皮之不存，毛将安傅？"

usage.en: Almost always the full saying 皮之不存，毛将焉附.
usage.zh: 多用全句"皮之不存，毛将焉附"。

natural: No one else in one's eyes

meaning.en: Arrogant; looking down on everyone.
meaning.zh: 眼里没有别人。形容骄傲自大，看不起人。

examples.zh: 他得了冠军后目中无人。
examples.en: After winning the title he looked down on everyone.

examples.zh: 别那么目中无人，山外有山。
examples.en: Don't be so arrogant — there's always someone better.

usage.en: Predicate.

meaning.en: Without turning a hair; perfectly calm in danger.
meaning.zh: 脸色不变。形容遇到危险时神态从容镇定。

examples.zh: 面对歹徒的刀，他面不改色。
examples.en: Facing the attacker's knife, he didn't bat an eyelid.

examples.zh: 她面不改色地说着谎。
examples.en: She lied without batting an eyelid.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Can praise courage or describe brazen lying.

meaning.en: As solid as a rock; utterly secure.
meaning.zh: 形容像泰山一样稳固，不可动摇。

examples.zh: 他在队里的位置稳如泰山。
examples.en: His place in the team is rock-solid.

examples.zh: 这座大桥经历了地震，依然稳如泰山。
examples.en: The bridge came through the earthquake as solid as ever.

usage.en: Predicate. Also 安如泰山.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"安如泰山"。

meaning.en: Anxious and fearful; in a state of alarm.
meaning.zh: 形容心中害怕，惊恐不安。

examples.zh: 裁员传闻让员工惶惶不安。
examples.en: Rumours of lay-offs have left staff jittery.

examples.zh: 疫情初期，人们惶惶不安。
examples.en: In the early days of the pandemic, people were in a state of alarm.

usage.en: Predicate.
